acceptance_criteria: Every animal has exactly one variant, legendary or mythic, named <word>_<species>; no normal animal is above epic; the Titan is legendary
build.py builds a jointed model for all eight animals and their eight variants under budget, and StationAssets.luau matches the manifest
In Studio play every model loads, stands on its feet and plays the shared animations with no script errors
Each egg type has its own model, and opening a finished egg plays a hatching animation
